messages:
Maria: Starting EU-WEST4 GPU region bring-up. Need to finalize Pulumi module changes, Terraform statebridge, and CI wiring. Putting checklist in this thread.

Kai: Key open items: subnet peering with shared-vpc, mgmt bastion, TF backend migration, GPU quota checks, and autoscaler IAM. I pushed a WIP PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/pulumi-regions/compare/feature/eu4-origami

Sophie: Link? I can't access it from my laptop right now.

Kai: oh right — public link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/pulumi-regions/pulls/78 (WIP)

Jamal: Pulumi change: added outputs for cluster_kubeconfig and exported kms_key. We also need to make sure `tf` state uses a GCS backend with locks. Proposed backend snippet: 
```hcl
terraform {
  backend "gcs" {
    bucket = "redwood-tf-state-eu-west4"
    prefix = "infra/regions/eu-west4"
  }
}
```

Maria: Agree. For the statebridge we'll run a one-time migration job: terraform import -> statebridge reconcile -> lock verification. @OpsBot can you schedule a maintenance window?

OpsBot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2034-11-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying on-call.

Kai: CI jobs we'll create/update: `infra/region-eu-west4-bootstrap`, `infra/statebridge-migrate-eu4`, `infra/pulumi-deploy-eu4`. CI needs new secrets: `PULUMI_ACCESS_TOKEN_EU4`, `TF_BACKEND_CREDS`. Also add a job to run `pulumi stack export` as a backup before migrations.

Sophie: I'll add the secrets to the infra repo and scope them to the `infra-ops` group.

Jamal: One tricky thing: A100-80GB GPUs in eu-west4 are quota-limited. @Maria can you open a quota request with the provider? We should also add fallback routing to eu-west1 for burst capacity.

Maria: Opened provider ticket #INC-4421 for quota increase and requested provisional capacity. Added fallback policy to the routing table: prefer eu-west4; fallback to eu-west1 on capacity.

Kai: Validation checklist before handoff:
1) TF state migrated and lock verified
2) Pulumi stack deployed to prod-eu-west4
3) Cluster autoscaler stress test (scale-up/down)
4) E2E latency smoke + perf tests against hosted API
5) Cost estimate verified and alerts configured for spend spikes

Sophie: For autoscaler stress test use k6 script: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m scripts/scale-smoke.js` and monitor node creation times / pod evictions.

CI-Bot: infra/statebridge-migrate-eu4: plan succeeded in 2m 12s — no changes.

Maria: :thumbsup: Starting `pulumi up` in canary now: `pulumi up --stack prod-eu-west4 --yes`

Jamal: Rollback plan if pulumi up fails: `pulumi stack export > backup.json` then `pulumi stack import backup.json --stack prod-eu-west4` and revert TF backend to previous state. Keep backup of TB state and Pulumi backup file.

OpsBot: On-call notified: @Sophie @Kai. Escalation: eng-sre if the migration takes >30m.

Maria: After canary looks good I'll hand off to infra-ops for formal runbook signoff and tag the runbook PR for review.
